question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses an unpleasant surprise faced by Cruz Banks regarding the kindergarten registration process.
 
• The most suitable word to describe the surprise in this context is "unpleasant", as it conveys the negative emotion Cruz Banks experienced when encountering the situation.
 
• The other options, "agreeable", "amusing", and "enjoyable", do not align with the negative tone of the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *Unfortunately, when she went to register her daughter for kindergarten, she was met with an (3) unpleasant__ surprise:*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Agreeable (सहमत): **"Agreeable" refers to something pleasant or agreeable, which does not fit the context of a surprise that Cruz Banks found unpleasant.
 
• **Amusing (मनोरंजक): **"Amusing" means something funny or entertaining, which does not convey the negative experience described in the passage.
 
• **Enjoyable (आनंददायक):** "Enjoyable" means something that is pleasurable or fun, which is the opposite of the situation described in the passage.
